author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN)
notes: Newest and sharpest frontal: receding temples, dark hair swept back, thick dark brows, full black beard about 2 cm with a clean cheek line, large protruding ears. Best image for face length, hairline, brows, nose and beard outline.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN)
notes: Full-body frontal cutout in black Venum compression shorts with a grey chevron-wave pattern. Long-limbed, lean but smooth physique with little ab definition and a soft lower belly; no tattoos; light body hair.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC studio portrait (served by ESPN)
notes: Full-body three-quarter cutout (body turned to his right, left side toward the camera) in the same shorts with red 'REYES' lettering down the left leg. Shows shoulder slope, arm length and the narrow waist from an angle.

author: Official White House Photo by Daniel Torok
license: Public domain (work of the US federal government)
date_taken: 2025-04-12 (UFC 314, Miami, after his KO of Nikita Krylov)
notes: Large, sharp three-quarter close-up looking down to his right, backwards cap, white Venum shirt. Beard at its longest (about 4-5 cm, dense, slightly curly at the edges). Best image for the nose (long, straight, slightly fleshy tip), the lip shape and the large, protruding LEFT ear with a pointed upper rim and no cauliflower. Post-fight redness in his left eye is temporary. Attribution: 'The White House / Daniel Torok'.
